gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-source-sans-3: Comic Relief brings a bold, commanding look with strokes that never swell or thin, and its rounded bowls stay incomplete. And Source Sans 3 follows in sans-serif form, modern and professional, with an a whose lower bowl opens up.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-stick:
Comic Relief draws bold, commanding letters with no thick-to-thin shifts.

Stick, the lighter sans, keeps tubelike lines whose exits let light through, so the heading shouts while the body simply gets on with it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-suse: Loud and friendly, Comic Relief shows strokes that never vary in thickness, with bowls that stay partly incomplete. But SUSE sits underneath in sans form, its rope-like curves and ladle-shaped openings giving the page a softer, approachable footing.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-suse-mono: Comic Relief has a stroke that never changes thickness, whatever direction it travels, giving its display letters a blunt, bold presence. SUSE Mono, the sans-serif partner, has open curves and extra space around each letter, so it can take a larger size than you might expect.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer is a clean, approachable sans-serif whose curves end like brush strokes lifted early. Comic Relief, with its thread-of-ink lines and no swelling or tapering, earns its keep in large headings.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-telex: Clean is the mood Telex sets, a sans-serif with curvy, unclamped letters. Comic Relief sits above it with a tube-like stroke resembling neon glass, loud where Telex stays low-key and neutral.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans is a neutral, contemporary sans-serif, with c tips that never creep toward touching and a light, visible stroke variation. And Comic Relief, with no hairlines or shadows, makes its bold, commanding strokes the pair's boldest quality.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tirra:
Tirra is a neutral, modern sans-serif with round forms like open parentheses.

Comic Relief above it has no pinched joints or flared ends, so the two feel like a loud, blunt voice next to a quietly curved one.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Clean describes Tsukimi Rounded, a plain sans with round forms like open parentheses and stroke edges running parallel through every curve. Comic Relief, bold and commanding above it, shouts where it whispers.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-tuffy: Professional in manner, Tuffy looks like a plain sans sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, and its s is widely parted. But Comic Relief above it is bold and commanding, so reading on down feels like stepping from a shout into an easy conversation.
